audit_metadata.title: Independent Evaluator Protocol Reconciliation & Execution-Boundary Audit
audit_metadata.auditor: Antigravity MLOps Security & ML Reproducibility Auditor

2_developer_evaluator_custody_separation.invariant: Developer has zero access to labels or decryption keys; keys never injected in developer environment

3_future_input_manifest_approval.invariant: Evaluator approves exact future input manifest after generation and before commitment; v2.1 reuse prohibited

4_remote_vs_local_ledger.invariant: DurableFileLedger is local development only; RemoteLedgerAdapter with Bearer auth and CAS required for evaluation

5_crash_safety_and_no_retry_rule.invariant: Fail-closed on ambiguous outcomes; no automatic retry permitted once labels may have been accessed

6_prediction_serialization_spec.spec: 1D numpy array, dtype='<f8' little-endian float64, contiguous bytes, bounded [0.0, 1.0], exact row ordering

7_aes_gcm_envelope_spec.spec: 12-byte CSPRNG nonce + ciphertext + 16-byte tag (minimum 28 bytes); constant-time tag verification, fail-closed

8_capacity_metric_definition.spec: Recall within floor(b * N) predictions; deterministic tie-breaking by order_id ascending; strict hard cap

9_calibration_and_metric_definitions.spec: ECE with 10 uniform bins on independent cohort; Brier score; PR-AUC continuous integral; prevalence baseline; ROC-AUC

10_pre_registration_of_promotion_thresho.invariant: Numerical promotion thresholds and acceptance criteria must be approved by Governance Board before holdout unblinding

11_synthetic_holdout_disclaimer.invariant: Synthetic holdout results do not establish real-market generalization; live shadow verification required
